title: Acquisitive Podcast Ep 05
description:
Episode 05: Nathan Platter

DEAL MAKER, Nathan Platter shares the ups and downs of vetting 62 deals to find the perfect fitness studio... that may not be so perfect. Take this journey with us as Nathan talks us through his acquisition and list as a ETA (entrepreneur through acquisition) over the last 5 months.


Check out Nathan's podcast: 
"Business Buyer Diaries: the Reality Before, During, and After"
